f8808a_adj_first_steps_then_abort.text: Adjustment stopped (operator). VDC was NOT completed (8 of 21 points were calibrated before the stop). The manual: a function that is not completely calibrated shows CAL ERROR (p. 3-16). The manual does not say whether the points already calibrated were stored or discarded: repeat the whole function and run the performance verification before using the meter. EXIT was sent over RS-232 (the manual's way to leave the calibration mode, p. 3-16). Look at the meter: if it still shows the calibration mode, press the SHIFT key at the front panel to leave it (owner-stated, not from the manual pages read).
